Career Portal

Become Part of the Klosterfrau Family

At Klosterfrau Group, you can build your future with a variety of career opportunities at a traditional company that employs over 1,500 people worldwide in consumer healthcare, medical services, contract manufacturing, and cosmetics.

No matter what department you are interested in — research and development, production, marketing, sales, or IT — you wigll find diverse career paths with us. Our locations in Cologne, Berlin, Munich, and Lüchow offer expertise in their respective areas and are part of a strong international group. We combine two hundred years of experience with innovation, forward-thinking, and a family-oriented work environment. Join the Klosterfrau Group and discover how you can contribute to our success story.

Go to the Career Portal

Career at Klosterfrau

Klosterfrau Award

With the Klosterfrau Award, which exists since 2001, the Klosterfrau Group underlines its commitment to excellence in research. At the same time, the award recognises and motivates the next generation of dedicated scientists who are committed to improving the quality of life of children with respiratory diseases.
